tv_telescope.statement: |E_t f-E_T f| <= (T-t) Delta for f in [0,1]
tv_telescope.basis: total-variation dual characterization and triangle inequality

localized_vc_deviation.basis: symmetrization, the standard VC entropy bound, Dudley's sqrt(log N) integral, Talagrand/Bernstein concentration, and dyadic peeling

erm_basic_inequality.basis: ERM empirical excess <=0, localized deviation, Massart variance control, and Young's inequality

between_epoch_transfer.statement: adds at most 2 W Delta to excess risk
between_epoch_transfer.basis: TV telescope for learner risk and optimal risk
